verdict.rationale: The Washington Department of Revenue is a government service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the My DOR portal sits behind an authenticated login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
